edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the sender into _transfer in transfer/transferFrom.
tx.origin is read for the blacklist check inside _transfer.
_isBlackListedBot gates every transfer for from, msg.sender and tx.origin.
_maxTxAmount caps the transferred amount.
_maxWalletSize caps the recipient balance after transfer.
uniswapV2Pair is compared against from and to to detect buys and sells.
guesttime decides whether buyers are added to the bot blacklist.
_transfer dispatches the final accounting to _tokenTransfer.
_transfer calls swapAndLiquify before the sender balance is updated.
_transfer ultimately reaches the standard reflection transfer path.
swapAndLiquify calls swapTokensForEth, entering an external swap.
swapAndLiquify calls addLiquidity with the derived amounts.
swapAndLiquify sends ETH to the marketing wallet.
swapAndLiquify sends ETH to the team wallet.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call.
addLiquidity performs the external addLiquidityETH call.
_tokenTransfer selects _transferStandard when neither side is excluded.
_transferStandard performs reflection arithmetic on fee and transfer amounts.
_transferStandard calls _getRValues to derive reflection amounts.
_getRValues multiplies amounts by the rate and subtracts fees.
buyFee values are applied when the sender is the pair.
sellFee values are applied when the recipient is the pair.
block.timestamp is used as the router deadline in swapTokensForEth.
block.timestamp is used as the router deadline in addLiquidity.
withdrawStuckETH forwards ETH to an owner-chosen recipient.
withdrawForeignToken calls transfer on an arbitrary ERC20 instance.
halloffameinu invokes _transferStandard to dump bot balances.
_rOwned balances are subtracted and added during the standard transfer.
_tOwned is written for excluded accounts in the transfer variants.
_rTotal is reduced by the reflection fee in _reflectFee.
msg.sender is used as the sender in transfer.
msg.sender is used as spender in transferFrom allowance accounting.
_allowances are read and decremented inside transferFrom.
msg.sender is the owner passed to _approve in approve.
addBotToBlacklist writes the blacklist mapping under onlyOwner.
the constructor assigns the entire _rTotal supply to _rOwned of the deployer.
the constructor creates and stores the Uniswap V2 pair address.
deliver subtracts reflection amounts and adds to the fee total.
setMaxTxPercent multiplies the total supply and divides by a thousand.
receive() lets the contract accept ETH produced by the router swap.
the router swap returns ETH into the contract through the receive function.
_approve writes the allowance mapping used by the router and transferFrom.
renounceOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier using _msgSender().
transferOwnership is gated by onlyOwner and requires a non-zero new owner.
the from parameter is the blacklist-checked sender inside _transfer.
the to parameter drives the wallet size and pair checks in _transfer.
the amount parameter is compared against limits and fee arithmetic.
contractTokenBalance is clamped and passed as the swap amount.
takeFee selects whether fee tiers are applied in _tokenTransfer.
the tokens parameter is split between liquidity and the ETH swap.
denominator scales the liquidity and distribution shares.
initialBalance snapshots the ETH balance before the router swap.
deltaBalance measures the ETH received from the router swap.
unitBalance determines the marketing ETH transfer amount.
tFee is routed to _reflectFee reducing the reflection supply.
tTransferAmount is the net amount credited to the recipient.
rAmount is subtracted from the sender reflection balance.
currentRate multiplies every token value inside _getRValues.
the account parameter is written into the blacklist mapping.
maxTxPercent scales _maxTxAmount through mul and div.
the tax parameter is stored into the buy and sell fee structures.
tAmount drives the reflection burn and fee accounting in deliver.
tokenAmount is approved and swapped through the router.
ethAmount is forwarded as value to the addLiquidityETH router call.
the recipient parameter is forwarded to _transfer from transfer.
